title: Bar Abaye or Abayah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 5:7: “A certain Bar Abayah passed before the ark.” At the end of Taanit, chapter 3, and in Sheviit 1:5: “Bar Abaye passed before the ark,” etc. Mavo HaYerushalmi holds that it is a term for a prayer leader.
